methods.name: Fibered equivariant-section / stabilizer fixed-lift calculus
capabilities: compute one stabilizer-fixed lift set per base orbit
enumerate equivariant sections by orbit propagation
methods.core_law: EQUIVARIANT_SECTION_EXISTS iff every base-orbit representative has a stabilizer-fixed point in its projection fiber; SECTION_COUNT is the product of those fixed-lift counts.
methods.hard_boundary: The projection, symmetry action and semantic naturality requirement must already be declared or derived. Infinite abstract groups must first be reduced to a proven finite permutation image on the relevant finite sets. The tool does not make the realization or naturality premise native.

methods.name: Triangular gauge normalization proof schema
capabilities: derive orbit count when independent residue ranges are proved
methods.note: Do not create a new tool family yet. Current evidence is one strong application plus overlap with ordinary integer precision/modular normalization. Promote only after a second independent application family supports a stable reusable API.

methods.name: Predictive minimality versus capacity-bound guard
capabilities: distinguish redundant-state minimization from height bounds
use J_m chain family as exact negative control for hidden capacity assumptions
methods.hard_boundary: A coarsest future-predictive quotient can still have arbitrarily large finite transient depth. Minimality/completeness alone never supplies a fixed state-count or height bound.
